units.source_text: 千重子记得父亲曾带她到周山赏花，摘了笔头菜就回去了。

en.t: Chieko remembered that her father had once taken her to Shuzan to see the flowers, and that after picking some horsetails they had gone straight home.
The horsetails were thick and long.

units.source_text: 此后，每次到高雄来，哪怕是一个人，她也要到北山的村庄走一趟。

en.t: After that, whenever she came to Takao, even if she was alone, she would always make a trip to the village of Kitayama.

units.source_text: 如今它已经合并到市里，成了北区中川北山町了。

en.t: Now it had already been incorporated into the city and had become Nakagawa Kitayama-cho in the Kita Ward.

units.source_text: 这里只有百二三十户人家，似乎叫作村更合适。

en.t: There were only about one hundred twenty or thirty households here, so it seemed more fitting to call it a village.
